author: kiwi654321
body:
From now on i'm not going to be going on Avicus much anymore, this is because I now play other games like CS:GO and such. Over the year or so playing on Avicus, I have really enjoyed it although I have been very toxic and rude at some points and to those people I am sorry.
I also have no interest in minecraft now at all apart from the occasional time I go onto kohi or something.

Thank you all for playing with me over this time and all the banter i've had with some people such as: 
 noah ,bmb,remy,tazz,ronloyd,caiden,zegita,jive,Robin,notal,robin,gurk,budah,creep,danikas,zew <3

I will come on from time to time but since the server is juan.8  so you know...

Thank you to everyone who played with me i have had 10/10 time

(ingigo i'm never telling you the secret on how  I stained you everytime we had a pvp battle xD)
 I aslo had a great run with bad company, i'll come on once in a while

Thank you, bye
